        callback = render(store, "slot", lambda value: f"[{value}]", defer=True)

item.text: The lease is only valid while `store.open(...)` is active, so the deferred callback must acquire and release the lease when it is invoked—not when the callback is created. This also preserves formatter behavior and ensures replacements made before invocation are observed consistently with deferred access.
